ex.en: This is the best method to solve that problem.
ex.zh: 這是解決那個問題的最佳辦法。

ex.en: Those kinds of methods are out of date.
ex.zh: 這種方法已經過時了。

ex.en: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.
ex.zh: 這個問題用一般的方法解決不了。

method.en: a particular way of doing something

ex.en: The paper explains its methodology in detail.
ex.zh: 這篇論文詳細說明了研究方法。

ex.en: Some scientists questioned the study's methodology.
ex.zh: 有些科學家質疑這項研究的方法。

methodology.en: the set of methods used to do a certain kind of study or work

ex.en: The distance between stars is measured in light years.
ex.zh: 恆星之間的距離是用光年來測量的。

ex.en: We measured the depth of the river.
ex.zh: 我們測量了這條河的深度。

measure.en: to find the size, amount or length of something

ex.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
ex.zh: 預防措施比實際治療有效得多。

ex.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
ex.zh: 駭客很擅長繞過電腦的安全措施。

measure.en: an action taken to deal with a problem

ex.en: I have been taking this medication for many years.
ex.zh: 這種藥我已經吃了很多年。

ex.en: I bought these medications for my father.
ex.zh: 這些藥是我幫我爸爸買的。

ex.en: Do you suffer from diseases that require medication?
ex.zh: 你有需要服藥的疾病嗎？

medication.en: a drug or pills that a doctor gives you to treat an illness

ex.en: The mechanic assembled the engine.
ex.zh: 技工把引擎組裝好了。

ex.en: Sami has just been to the mechanic.
ex.zh: 薩米剛去找過修車師傅。

ex.en: The mechanic said the brakes need to be replaced.
ex.zh: 修車師傅說剎車需要更換。

mechanic.en: a person whose job is to repair machines, especially cars

ex.en: The news of the merger of the two companies broke yesterday.
ex.zh: 兩家公司合併的消息昨天傳出。

ex.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
ex.zh: 合併打亂了一切，辦公室從那之後就一團混亂。

ex.en: The merger will create the largest bank in the country.
ex.zh: 這次合併將會產生國內最大的銀行。

merger.en: the joining of two companies into one

ex.en: The manager sent a memorandum to all staff.
ex.zh: 經理發了一份備忘錄給全體員工。

ex.en: Please read the memorandum before the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會前請先看過這份備忘錄。

memorandum.en: a short written note sent to people in the same organization

ex.en: The two companies signed a memorandum of understanding.
ex.zh: 兩家公司簽署了合作備忘錄。

ex.en: A memorandum of understanding is usually not legally binding.
ex.zh: 合作備忘錄通常不具法律約束力。

memorandum.en: a written agreement that states what two sides plan to do together

ex.en: I got a piece of lead for my mechanical pencil from her.
ex.zh: 我跟她拿了一根自動鉛筆的筆芯。

ex.en: The flight was delayed due to a mechanical problem.
ex.zh: 航班因機械故障而延誤。

mechanical.en: related to machines or operated by a machine

ex.en: His answer sounded mechanical.
ex.zh: 他的回答聽起來很機械化。

ex.en: Data entry is a boring, mechanical task.
ex.zh: 資料輸入是一項無聊又機械化的工作。

mechanical.en: done without thought or feeling, as if by habit

meantime.zh: in the meantime：在此期間、同時

ex.en: The doctor will see you soon. In the meantime, please fill out this form.
ex.zh: 醫生很快就會看你，這段時間請先填這張表。

ex.en: Your new card will arrive next week; in the meantime, use this one.
ex.zh: 你的新卡下週會寄到，在那之前先用這張。

meantime.en: during the time between two events

ex.en: The Mitsubishi Bank merged with the Bank of Tokyo.
ex.zh: 三菱銀行和東京銀行合併了。

ex.en: The two companies merged last year.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司去年合併了。

merge.en: to join together to become one company or group

ex.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
ex.zh: 分支和合併是版本控制的兩個基本操作。

ex.en: Can you merge these two files into one?
ex.zh: 你可以把這兩個檔案合併成一個嗎？

merge.en: to combine two or more files or sets of data into one

ex.en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
ex.zh: 移到左邊車道，讓那輛想切進來的車有空間。

ex.en: Be careful when you merge onto the highway.
ex.zh: 開上高速公路併入車道時要小心。

merge.en: to join a stream of traffic on a road

messenger.zh: 送信人、信差；傳遞消息的人

ex.en: The company sent a messenger to deliver the documents.
ex.zh: 公司派了一位專人送文件。

ex.en: Don't blame the messenger for the bad news.
ex.zh: 壞消息不要怪傳話的人。

messenger.en: a person who carries messages or packages to others

ex.en: Everyone listened and was very happy, thinking this wedding was both original and meaningful.
ex.zh: 大家聽了都很高興，覺得這場婚禮既新穎又有意義。

ex.en: Volunteering was a meaningful experience for me.
ex.zh: 當志工對我來說是很有意義的經驗。

meaningful.en: having a clear purpose or importance

ex.en: She gave me a meaningful look.
ex.zh: 她意味深長地看了我一眼。

ex.en: He gave her a meaningful smile.
ex.zh: 他意味深長地對她笑了笑。

meaningful.en: expressing a hidden idea or feeling without words

ex.en: I've memorized the model number of the charger.
ex.zh: 我記住了充電器的型號。

ex.en: Have you got this number memorized?
ex.zh: 這個號碼你背起來了嗎？

ex.en: I need to memorize these words for the test.
ex.zh: 我得為考試背這些單字。

memorize.en: to learn something so well that you can remember it exactly

ex.en: Merchants only look at the profits.
ex.zh: 商人只看重利潤。

ex.en: The merchant sold silk and tea.
ex.zh: 那位商人販售絲綢和茶葉。

ex.en: Online merchants must protect customer data.
ex.zh: 線上商家必須保護顧客資料。

merchant.en: a person who buys and sells goods, especially in large amounts

ex.en: With all her merits she was not proud.
ex.zh: 儘管她有那麼多優點，卻一點也不驕傲。

ex.en: Each proposal will be judged on its merits.
ex.zh: 每份提案都會依其本身的優劣來評斷。

ex.en: The plan has some merit.
ex.zh: 這個計畫有它的可取之處。

merit.en: a good quality that makes something worth praise or support

ex.en: The idea merits further discussion.
ex.zh: 這個想法值得進一步討論。

ex.en: His performance merits a promotion.
ex.zh: 他的表現值得升職。

merit.en: to deserve something because of being good or important

ex.en: This chocolate factory consumes twenty metric tons of raw cocoa per day.
ex.zh: 這座巧克力工廠每天消耗二十公噸的可可原料。

ex.en: Taiwan uses the metric system.
ex.zh: 台灣使用公制。

metric.en: using the system of measurement based on meters and grams

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is a key metric for us.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意度是我們的重要指標。

ex.en: We track several metrics on our website.
ex.zh: 我們追蹤網站上的幾項指標。

metric.en: a standard or number used to judge how well something is doing

ex.en: The median of 3, 5, and 9 is 5.
ex.zh: 3、5、9 的中位數是 5。

ex.en: Half of the salaries are above the median.
ex.zh: 有一半的薪資高於中位數。

median.en: the middle number in a group of numbers arranged in order

ex.en: The median price of a home here is very high.
ex.zh: 這裡房價的中位數非常高。

ex.en: What is the median age of our customers?
ex.zh: 我們客戶年齡的中位數是多少？

median.en: being the middle value in a group of numbers

ex.en: "Call up" is a phrase that means to telephone.
ex.zh: 「call up」這個片語的意思是打電話。

ex.en: I couldn't make out what he meant by 'megafeps'.
ex.zh: 我搞不懂他說的「megafeps」是什麼意思。

mean.en: to have a certain meaning when said or written

ex.en: Swimming in the sea doesn't mean owning the sea.
ex.zh: 在海裡游泳不代表擁有大海。

ex.en: Missing the train means being late for work.
ex.zh: 錯過火車就代表上班會遲到。

mean.en: to show that something is true or will happen

ex.en: I didn't mean to hurt you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要傷害你的。

ex.en: I've been meaning to call you.
ex.zh: 我一直想打電話給你。

mean.en: to plan or want to do something

ex.en: Don't be mean to your sister.
ex.zh: 別對你妹妹那麼刻薄。

ex.en: That was a mean thing to say.
ex.zh: 那樣說太刻薄了。

mean.en: unkind or unfair to other people

ex.en: We are to meet him at seven this evening.
ex.zh: 我們今晚七點要跟他見面。

ex.en: Let's meet at the station.
ex.zh: 我們在車站碰面吧。

meet.en: to come together with someone, by plan or by chance

ex.en: It was in Kyoto that I first met her.
ex.zh: 我第一次見到她是在京都。

ex.en: I met my wife at university.
ex.zh: 我在大學時認識我太太。

meet.en: to see and talk to someone for the first time

meet.zh: 滿足、符合（需求、標準、期限）

ex.en: I don't know anyone who meets that description.
ex.zh: 我不認識符合那種描述的人。

ex.en: We must meet the deadline.
ex.zh: 我們必須趕上截止期限。

ex.en: The product meets all safety standards.
ex.zh: 這項產品符合所有安全標準。

meet.en: to be good enough for a need, a rule or a time limit

ex.en: Tom is no longer a member of this club.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經不是這個俱樂部的成員了。

ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
ex.zh: 每位會員每個月要繳一萬日圓。

ex.en: Four-fifths of all the members were against the plan.
ex.zh: 五分之四的會員反對這項計畫。

member.en: a person who belongs to a group or club

ex.en: This is the car Linda mentioned yesterday.
ex.zh: 這就是琳達昨天提到的那輛車。

ex.en: She never mentioned she had a sister.
ex.zh: 她從沒提過她有姊妹。

ex.en: As I mentioned in my email, the meeting is on Friday.
ex.zh: 如我在電子郵件中提到的，會議在星期五。

mention.en: to talk or write about something briefly

ex.en: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
ex.zh: 他會德文和法文，更不用說英文了。

ex.en: She speaks German and French, not to mention English.
ex.zh: 她會說德文和法文，更不用說英文了。

mention.en: used to add something that is even more important

ex.en: "Thank you for helping me." "Don't mention it."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你幫我。」「不客氣。」

ex.en: "Thanks for the ride." "Don't mention it."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你載我。」「不客氣。」

mention.en: a polite reply to someone who has thanked you

ex.en: I believe the medium size will fit you better.
ex.zh: 我想中號會比較適合您。

ex.en: You only need a medium size.
ex.zh: 您只需要中號就夠了。

ex.en: My gloves are size medium.
ex.zh: 我的手套是中號的。

medium.en: of a size or amount between small and large

ex.en: I'd like my steak medium, please.
ex.zh: 我的牛排要五分熟，謝謝。

ex.en: Would you like it medium or well-done?
ex.zh: 您要五分熟還是全熟？

medium.en: cooked so that the meat is a little pink inside

ex.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
ex.zh: 它是一種溝通媒介，而不是物質或特定的活動。

ex.en: Television is a powerful advertising medium.
ex.zh: 電視是很有影響力的廣告媒介。

medium.en: a way of communicating or expressing something

ex.en: The older we become, the worse our memory gets.
ex.zh: 我們年紀越大，記憶力就越差。

ex.en: Neither Tom nor Mary has a very good memory.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗的記憶都不好。

ex.en: The picture brought back a lot of memories.
ex.zh: 那張照片勾起了很多回憶。

ex.en: The memories we make with our family are everything.
ex.zh: 和家人一起創造的回憶就是一切。

ex.en: The event is still fresh in our memory.
ex.zh: 那件事在我們的記憶中仍然很鮮明。

memory.en: something that you remember from the past

ex.en: My phone is running out of memory.
ex.zh: 我的手機記憶體快不夠了。

ex.en: This laptop has 16 GB of memory.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有 16 GB 的記憶體。

memory.en: the part of a computer or phone where information is stored

ex.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 目前急需醫療用品。

ex.en: She made a series of medical discoveries.
ex.zh: 她有一連串的醫學發現。

ex.en: You need a medical certificate for sick leave.
ex.zh: 請病假需要診斷證明。

medical.en: related to the treatment of illness and injury

ex.en: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
ex.zh: 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。

ex.en: He lets his workers eat meals in the office.
ex.zh: 他讓員工在辦公室吃飯。

ex.en: We eat a meal three times a day.
ex.zh: 我們一天吃三餐。

meal.en: food that you eat at a certain time of the day

ex.en: Let's have a meal together after work.
ex.zh: 下班後一起吃頓飯吧。

ex.en: We had a nice meal at the hotel restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們在飯店餐廳吃了一頓不錯的飯。

meal.en: to eat food at a certain time of the day

ex.en: Mental health is as important as physical health.
ex.zh: 心理健康和身體健康一樣重要。

ex.en: His trouble was chiefly mental.
ex.zh: 他的問題主要是心理上的。

ex.en: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.
ex.zh: 移民們承受了身心的痛苦。

mental.en: related to the mind and thoughts

mental.zh: 心智的、腦力的；在心裡進行的

ex.en: Doing puzzles is good mental exercise.
ex.zh: 玩益智遊戲是很好的腦力訓練。

ex.en: I made a mental note to call her later.
ex.zh: 我在心裡記下晚點要打給她。

mental.en: done by thinking, or done in your head without writing

ex.en: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
ex.zh: 在這期間，情況發生了很大的變化。

ex.en: I'll cook dinner. Meanwhile, you can set the table.
ex.zh: 我來煮晚餐，你可以同時擺好餐具。

meanwhile.en: during the same period of time

ex.en: Sales in Asia rose. Meanwhile, sales in Europe fell.
ex.zh: 亞洲的銷售額上升，另一方面，歐洲的銷售額卻下滑了。

ex.en: Prices keep rising; meanwhile, salaries stay the same.
ex.zh: 物價持續上漲，薪水卻原地不動。

meanwhile.en: used to compare two different situations at the same time

ex.en: Don't look down on him merely because he is poor.
ex.zh: 不要只因為他窮就看不起他。

ex.en: He said it merely as a joke.
ex.zh: 他只是開玩笑說說而已。

ex.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
ex.zh: 勞動不只是必要的，也是一種樂趣。

merely.en: used to show that something is only what you say and nothing more

ex.en: Copper and silver are both metals.
ex.zh: 銅和銀都是金屬。

ex.en: Metals contract when they cool.
ex.zh: 金屬遇冷會收縮。

ex.en: The acid ate into the metal.
ex.zh: 酸腐蝕了金屬。

metal.en: a hard, shiny material such as iron, gold or copper

ex.en: Please put all metal objects in the tray.
ex.zh: 請把所有金屬物品放進托盤。

ex.en: The box has a metal lid.
ex.zh: 這個盒子有金屬蓋子。

metal.en: made of iron, steel or a similar hard material

ex.en: We need a better mechanism for handling complaints.
ex.zh: 我們需要更好的客訴處理機制。

ex.en: The body has natural defense mechanisms.
ex.zh: 人體有天然的防禦機制。

mechanism.en: a system or method for doing something

ex.en: The clock's mechanism is very delicate.
ex.zh: 這個時鐘的機械構造非常精細。

ex.en: The door has a simple locking mechanism.
ex.zh: 這扇門有一個簡單的鎖定裝置。

mechanism.en: the set of moving parts inside a machine

ex.en: From now on, I will not eat meat anymore.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我不再吃肉了。

ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: Could you cook this meat a little more?
ex.zh: 這塊肉可以再煮久一點嗎？

meat.en: the flesh of animals that people eat as food

ex.en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這個鎮位於海拔 1,500 公尺。

ex.en: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.
ex.zh: 工廠面積是 1,000 平方公尺。

ex.en: The plane flew at an altitude of 3,000 meters.
ex.zh: 飛機在 3,000 公尺的高度飛行。

meter.en: a unit of length equal to one hundred centimeters

meter.zh: 計量器、錶（如電錶、計程車跳錶）

ex.en: I need it for the parking meter.
ex.zh: 我要用它來投停車計時器。

ex.en: The taxi driver forgot to turn on the meter.
ex.zh: 計程車司機忘了按跳錶。

meter.en: a device that measures and shows an amount such as use of electricity or time

ex.en: I applied for membership in the association.
ex.zh: 我申請加入這個協會成為會員。

ex.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
ex.zh: 加入不需要繳會費。

ex.en: Your gym membership expires next month.
ex.zh: 你的健身房會員資格下個月到期。

membership.en: the state of belonging to a group or club

ex.en: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
ex.zh: 真是一團糟，讓我很心煩。

ex.en: If you make a mess, clean it up.
ex.zh: 如果你弄亂了，就要自己收拾乾淨。

ex.en: Sorry about the mess in my room.
ex.zh: 不好意思，我房間很亂。

mess.en: a dirty or untidy state, or a difficult situation

ex.en: I realize I messed up.
ex.zh: 我知道我搞砸了。

ex.en: You messed up.
ex.zh: 你搞砸了。

mess.en: to do something badly, or to make a place untidy

ex.en: Accurate measurement is important in science.
ex.zh: 精確的測量在科學上很重要。

ex.en: The measurement showed a small increase in temperature.
ex.zh: 測量結果顯示溫度略有上升。

measurement.en: the act of finding the size, amount or length of something

ex.en: The tailor took my measurements.
ex.zh: 裁縫師幫我量了尺寸。

ex.en: Please check the measurements of the room.
ex.zh: 請確認房間的尺寸。

measurement.en: the size, length or amount of something that has been found out

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 光是想到蛇就讓我發抖。

ex.en: Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
ex.zh: 我們目前的危機絕不只是經濟危機。

ex.en: She is a mere child.
ex.zh: 她只是個孩子。

mere.en: used to stress that something is small or unimportant

ex.en: The cell membrane protects the cell.
ex.zh: 細胞膜保護細胞。

ex.en: The waterproof membrane keeps your feet dry.
ex.zh: 這層防水薄膜能讓雙腳保持乾燥。

membrane.en: a thin layer of material that covers or separates parts of a body or plant

ex.en: Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天吃鮪魚罐頭，結果汞中毒了。

ex.en: Old thermometers contain mercury.
ex.zh: 舊式溫度計含有水銀。

mercury.en: a heavy silver metal that is liquid at normal temperatures

ex.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
ex.zh: 水星是我們太陽系中最小的行星。

ex.en: That one over there is Mercury.
ex.zh: 那邊那顆是水星。

mercury.en: the planet closest to the sun

ex.en: Exercise can speed up your metabolism.
ex.zh: 運動可以加快新陳代謝。

ex.en: Metabolism slows down as we get older.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，新陳代謝會變慢。

metabolism.en: the chemical processes in the body that change food into energy

ex.en: The poet uses the sea as a metaphor for freedom.
ex.zh: 詩人用大海來比喻自由。

ex.en: The writer's metaphors make the story vivid.
ex.zh: 作者的比喻讓故事更生動。

metaphor.en: a way of describing something by saying it is something else

metal detector.zh: 金屬探測器（機場安檢等）

ex.en: Please walk through the metal detector one at a time.
ex.zh: 請一次一位走過金屬探測器。

ex.en: The metal detector beeped because of my belt.
ex.zh: 金屬探測器因為我的皮帶而嗶嗶作響。

metal detector.en: a machine that finds hidden objects made of iron, steel or similar materials

ex.en: The store sells merchandise from local designers.
ex.zh: 這家店販售本地設計師的商品。

ex.en: You can buy official band merchandise at the concert.
ex.zh: 你可以在演唱會上買到樂團官方周邊商品。

merchandise.en: goods that are bought and sold

ex.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
ex.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的菜。

ex.en: They're at the restaurant looking at the menu.
ex.zh: 他們在餐廳裡看菜單。

ex.en: How many different kinds of pizzas are on the menu?
ex.zh: 菜單上有幾種披薩？

menu.en: a list of the food and drinks that you can order in a restaurant

ex.en: Click the menu in the top left corner.
ex.zh: 點左上角的選單。

ex.en: Choose "Settings" from the menu.
ex.zh: 從選單中選擇「設定」。

menu.en: a list of choices shown on a screen

ex.en: I have to take my medicine every six hours.
ex.zh: 我每六小時要吃一次藥。

ex.en: These medicines should be taken three times a day.
ex.zh: 這些藥一天吃三次。

ex.en: There aren't any medicines that can cure this disease.
ex.zh: 沒有藥能治好這種病。

medicine.en: a substance that you take to treat an illness

ex.en: Which aspects of Chinese medicine do you specialise in?
ex.zh: 您專攻中醫的哪個領域？

ex.en: She is studying medicine at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學念醫學系。

medicine.en: the science and study of treating illness and injury

ex.en: I'm playing a medieval-themed PC game.
ex.zh: 我正在玩一款中世紀主題的電腦遊戲。

ex.en: We visited a medieval castle in Germany.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了德國的一座中世紀城堡。

medieval.en: related to the period of European history from about 500 to 1500

ex.en: The philosopher wrote about metaphysical questions such as the nature of time.
ex.zh: 那位哲學家探討了時間本質之類的形而上學問題。

ex.en: Many metaphysical ideas cannot be tested by experiments.
ex.zh: 許多形而上學的觀念無法用實驗來檢驗。

metaphysical.en: related to deep ideas about the nature of existence and reality

ex.en: Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
ex.zh: 酒駕者是對路上所有人的威脅。

ex.en: The new law aims to protect citizens from the menace of crime.
ex.zh: 新法律旨在保護市民免受犯罪的威脅。

menace.en: a person or thing that is likely to cause harm

ex.en: The little girl laughed a merry laugh.
ex.zh: 小女孩高興地笑了。

ex.en: I wish you a Merry Christmas.
ex.zh: 祝你聖誕節快樂。

ex.en: Merry Christmas, my love!
ex.zh: 親愛的，聖誕節快樂！

ex.en: The wine has a rich, mellow flavor.
ex.zh: 這支酒的味道濃郁香醇。

ex.en: The singer has a warm, mellow voice.
ex.zh: 這位歌手的嗓音溫暖柔和。

mellow.en: soft, smooth and pleasant in taste or sound

ex.en: You two are really harshing my mellow.
ex.zh: 你們倆真掃我的雅興。

ex.en: He has grown mellow with age.
ex.zh: 他隨著年紀增長變得隨和圓熟。

mellow.en: relaxed, calm and easy to get along with

ex.en: The meek boy never argued with anyone.
ex.zh: 那個溫順的男孩從來不跟人爭執。

ex.en: She gave a meek reply and looked at the floor.
ex.zh: 她低聲下氣地回答並看著地板。

meek.en: quiet, gentle and not willing to argue

ex.en: A feeling of melancholy came over him as autumn arrived.
ex.zh: 秋天一到，他心中湧起一股憂鬱。

ex.en: The old song filled her with melancholy.
ex.zh: 那首老歌使她充滿憂傷。

melancholy.en: a feeling of deep sadness that lasts a long time

ex.en: He wore a melancholy expression all day.
ex.zh: 他整天都帶著憂鬱的神情。

ex.en: The melancholy music matched the rainy evening.
ex.zh: 憂傷的音樂與雨夜十分相配。

ex.en: Love is like the measles; we all have to go through it.
ex.zh: 愛情就像麻疹──一生總要經歷一次。

ex.en: Children should get vaccinated against measles.
ex.zh: 兒童應該接種麻疹疫苗。

ex.en: Measles spreads very easily through coughing and sneezing.
ex.zh: 麻疹很容易透過咳嗽和打噴嚏傳染。

measles.en: an illness that gives children a fever and red spots on the skin

ex.en: Tom was there physically, but not mentally.
ex.zh: 湯姆人在心不在。

ex.en: You must be mentally exhausted.
ex.zh: 你一定精神上很疲憊。

ex.en: Exercise keeps you healthy both physically and mentally.
ex.zh: 運動讓你身心都保持健康。

mentally.en: in a way that is related to the mind

ex.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
ex.zh: 攀比心理會讓人產生負面情緒。

ex.en: He has a winning mentality and never gives up easily.
ex.zh: 他有求勝的心態，從不輕易放棄。

ex.en: The older generation often has a different mentality about money.
ex.zh: 老一輩的人對金錢的想法往往不太一樣。

mentality.en: a way of thinking that is typical of a person or group

ex.en: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.
ex.zh: 媒體重創了他的名聲。

ex.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
ex.zh: 在這件事情上，我覺得那些垃圾媒體只報導片面的資訊。

ex.en: The news spread quickly through the media.
ex.zh: 這則消息透過媒體迅速傳開。

media.en: television, newspapers, the internet and other ways of giving news to many people

ex.en: My mentor helped me a lot in my first year.
ex.zh: 我的導師在我第一年幫了我很多。

ex.en: Every new employee is paired with a mentor.
ex.zh: 每位新進員工都會分配一位指導者。

mentor.en: an experienced person who gives advice and help to a less experienced one

ex.en: She mentors young designers in her free time.
ex.zh: 她空閒時會指導年輕設計師。

ex.en: Senior engineers are expected to mentor junior staff.
ex.zh: 資深工程師要負責指導資淺同事。

mentor.en: to give advice and help to a less experienced person over time

memo.zh: 備忘錄、（公司內部的）通知

ex.en: The manager sent a memo about the new dress code.
ex.zh: 經理發了一份關於新服裝規定的通知。

ex.en: Did you read the memo from HR?
ex.zh: 你看過人資部發的備忘錄了嗎？

memo.en: a short written note sent to people in the same organization

ex.en: The mentorship program pairs new hires with senior staff.
ex.zh: 導師制度會安排新進員工與資深同事配對。

ex.en: She gained valuable advice through mentorship.
ex.zh: 她透過導師指導獲得了寶貴建議。

mentorship.en: a system or period in which an experienced person guides a less experienced one

ex.en: HR stepped in to mediate between the two employees.
ex.zh: 人資部介入調解兩位員工之間的糾紛。

ex.en: A neutral country offered to mediate the dispute.
ex.zh: 一個中立國表示願意居中斡旋這場爭端。

mediate.en: to try to end an argument between two sides by talking to both

ex.en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
ex.zh: 你們打算參加會議嗎？

ex.en: He tends to be late for meetings.
ex.zh: 他開會常常遲到。

ex.en: Only a few people came to the meeting yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天只有幾個人來開會。

meeting.en: an event where people come together to talk and make decisions

ex.en: There is little chance of my meeting him again.
ex.zh: 我大概不會再見到他了。

ex.en: Our first meeting was at a friend's wedding.
ex.zh: 我們第一次見面是在朋友的婚禮上。

meeting.en: the act of coming together with someone

ex.en: Would you like to leave a message for him?
ex.zh: 你想留個訊息給他嗎？

ex.en: I haven't gotten any messages from him since then.
ex.zh: 從那之後，我就沒再收到他的任何消息。

ex.en: If she should come late, give her this message.
ex.zh: 如果她回來晚了，把這個口信轉告她。

message.en: a piece of information that you send or leave for another person

ex.en: Cycling is a cheap means of transport.
ex.zh: 騎腳踏車是一種便宜的交通方式。

ex.en: We need a better means of reaching our customers.
ex.zh: 我們需要更好的方法來接觸客戶。

ex.en: He lives beyond his means.
ex.zh: 他過著入不敷出的生活。

ex.en: A person of means can afford this house.
ex.zh: 有財力的人才買得起這間房子。

ex.en: What is the meaning of this word?
ex.zh: 這個字是什麼意思？

ex.en: The poem has a deeper meaning.
ex.zh: 這首詩有更深一層的含義。

ex.en: Helping others gives her life meaning.
ex.zh: 幫助別人讓她的生活有意義。

ex.en: His words had no real meaning for me.
ex.zh: 他的話對我來說沒有什麼真正的意義。

ex.en: The pool is twenty-five metres long.
ex.zh: 這個游泳池長二十五公尺。

ex.en: He ran one hundred metres in under fourteen seconds.
ex.zh: 他在十四秒內跑完一百公尺。

ex.en: She won a gold medal at the swimming meet.
ex.zh: 她在游泳比賽中贏得一面金牌。

ex.en: The soldier received a medal for his bravery.
ex.zh: 那位軍人因英勇行為獲頒勳章。

ex.en: The snow began to melt in the spring sun.
ex.zh: 雪在春天的陽光下開始融化。

ex.en: Chocolate melts quickly in hot weather.
ex.zh: 巧克力在炎熱的天氣裡很快就融化。

ex.en: Her kind words made his anger melt away.
ex.zh: 她親切的話讓他的怒氣消散了。

ex.en: My heart melted when I saw the tiny kitten.
ex.zh: 我看到那隻小貓時，心都融化了。

ex.en: Taipei is a large metropolitan area.
ex.zh: 台北是個大都會區。

ex.en: Many people commute within the metropolitan region.
ex.zh: 許多人在大都會區內通勤。

ex.en: We visited the war memorial in the city center.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了市中心的戰爭紀念碑。

ex.en: Flowers were left at the memorial.
ex.zh: 有人在紀念碑前放了花。

ex.en: A memorial service was held for the teacher.
ex.zh: 為那位老師舉行了追思會。

ex.en: They planted a memorial tree in the park.
ex.zh: 他們在公園裡種了一棵紀念樹。

ex.en: The judge showed mercy because it was his first mistake.
ex.zh: 法官因為這是他的初犯而從輕發落。

ex.en: They begged the king for mercy.
ex.zh: 他們向國王求饒。

ex.en: She has no mercy when she plays chess.
ex.zh: 她下棋時毫不留情。

ex.en: It was a mercy that no one was hurt in the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中沒有人受傷，真是萬幸。

ex.en: We are grateful for small mercies on a hard day.
ex.zh: 在艱難的一天裡，我們對小小的幸運心懷感激。

mercy.zh: 任憑擺布、受制於（at the mercy of）

ex.en: The small boat was at the mercy of the waves.
ex.zh: 那艘小船任由海浪擺布。

ex.en: Farmers are often at the mercy of the weather.
ex.zh: 農民常常得看天吃飯。

ex.en: Please give me a moment to think.
ex.zh: 請給我一點時間想一想。

ex.en: He asked me to wait outside.
ex.zh: 他要我在外面等。

ex.en: Do you want to come with me?
ex.zh: 你要跟我一起去嗎？

ex.en: Our new classmate is a Mexican who loves soccer.
ex.zh: 我們的新同學是個愛踢足球的墨西哥人。

ex.en: Many Mexicans celebrate the Day of the Dead in autumn.
ex.zh: 許多墨西哥人在秋天慶祝亡靈節。

ex.en: We had Mexican tacos for lunch today.
ex.zh: 我們今天午餐吃了墨西哥塔可餅。

ex.en: There is a Mexican restaurant on the corner of our street.
ex.zh: 我們那條街的轉角有一家墨西哥餐廳。

ex.en: Mexico is a country in North America.
ex.zh: 墨西哥是北美洲的一個國家。

ex.en: People in Mexico speak Spanish.
ex.zh: 墨西哥人說西班牙語。

ex.en: Merseyside is a county in northwest England, and the city of Liverpool is part of it.
ex.zh: 默西賽德郡位於英格蘭西北部，利物浦市就在其中。

ex.en: Many visitors travel to Merseyside to see its historic docks and museums.
ex.zh: 許多遊客前往默西賽德郡參觀歷史悠久的碼頭和博物館。

ex.en: I can't remember the words, but I know the melody.
ex.zh: 我記不得歌詞，但記得那段旋律。

ex.en: The singer's voice carried a sweet melody through the room.
ex.zh: 歌手的聲音讓一段優美的旋律傳遍整個房間。

ex.en: The retired teacher wrote a memoir about her years in the countryside.
ex.zh: 那位退休教師寫了一本回憶錄，記錄她在鄉下的歲月。

ex.en: I borrowed a memoir by a famous chef from the library.
ex.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本知名主廚的回憶錄。

ex.en: Cows were eating grass in the green meadow.
ex.zh: 乳牛在綠色的草地上吃草。

ex.en: Children ran through the meadow full of wild flowers.
ex.zh: 孩子們跑過開滿野花的草地。

ex.en: Our trip to the mountains was truly memorable.
ex.zh: 我們的山區之旅真的令人難忘。

ex.en: She gave a memorable speech at the graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 她在畢業典禮上發表了一場令人難忘的演說。

ex.en: The band's name is short and memorable.
ex.zh: 這個樂團的名字簡短又好記。

ex.en: She does ten minutes of meditation every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上做十分鐘的冥想。

ex.en: Meditation helps me feel calm after a busy day.
ex.zh: 冥想幫助我在忙碌一天後感到平靜。

ex.en: He sat in quiet meditation by the lake.
ex.zh: 他在湖邊靜靜地沉思。

ex.en: His room is always messy after the weekend.
ex.zh: 週末過後，他的房間總是亂七八糟的。

ex.en: Her messy desk was covered with papers.
ex.zh: 她凌亂的書桌上堆滿了紙。

ex.en: The kids made a messy kitchen while baking.
ex.zh: 孩子們烤東西時把廚房弄得髒兮兮的。

ex.en: Eating spaghetti can be a messy business.
ex.zh: 吃義大利麵可能會吃得髒兮兮的。

ex.en: They went through a messy divorce.
ex.zh: 他們經歷了一場棘手的離婚。

ex.en: The situation got messy when both sides refused to talk.
ex.zh: 雙方都拒絕談判後，情況變得棘手起來。

ex.en: Meg is short for Margaret.
ex.zh: Meg 是 Margaret 的簡稱。

ex.en: Meg lives next door and loves gardening.
ex.zh: 梅格住在隔壁，很愛種花。

ex.en: Without a clear goal, the work felt meaningless to him.
ex.zh: 沒有明確的目標，這份工作讓他覺得毫無意義。

ex.en: The speech was full of meaningless words and empty promises.
ex.zh: 這場演講充滿空洞的話與落空的承諾。

ex.en: I take the metro to work every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上搭捷運上班。

ex.en: The metro station is a five-minute walk from here.
ex.zh: 捷運站離這裡走路五分鐘。

ex.en: She mended the hole in my sweater.
ex.zh: 她把我毛衣上的洞補好了。

ex.en: Dad mended the broken chair with glue.
ex.zh: 爸爸用膠水把壞掉的椅子修好了。

ex.en: They tried to mend their friendship after the fight.
ex.zh: 吵架後他們試著修復友誼。

ex.en: A sincere apology can help mend a broken relationship.
ex.zh: 誠懇的道歉能幫助修補破裂的關係。

ex.en: The broken bone will mend in six weeks.
ex.zh: 斷掉的骨頭六週後會癒合。

ex.en: His wound is mending nicely.
ex.zh: 他的傷口恢復得很好。

ex.en: They enjoy a Mediterranean diet with lots of olive oil.
ex.zh: 他們吃的是大量使用橄欖油的地中海飲食。

ex.en: The island has a warm Mediterranean climate.
ex.zh: 這座島有溫暖的地中海型氣候。

ex.en: We spent our summer holiday by the Mediterranean.
ex.zh: 我們在地中海邊度過暑假。

ex.en: Many ships cross the Mediterranean every day.
ex.zh: 每天都有許多船隻橫越地中海。

ex.en: The fish escaped through the holes in the mesh.
ex.zh: 魚從網眼的洞鑽走了。

ex.en: A wire mesh covers the window to keep insects out.
ex.zh: 窗戶上裝了金屬網來擋住蟲子。

ex.en: The two gears mesh smoothly.
ex.zh: 這兩個齒輪嚙合得很順暢。

ex.en: Their ideas did not mesh with the company's plans.
ex.zh: 他們的想法和公司的計畫並不契合。

ex.en: My uncle drives a silver Mercedes.
ex.zh: 我叔叔開一輛銀色的賓士車。

ex.en: Mercedes is a German car brand.
ex.zh: 賓士是德國的汽車品牌。

ex.en: The two companies agreed to try mediation before going to court.
ex.zh: 兩家公司同意在上法院之前先試試調解。

ex.en: Her mediation helped the neighbors settle their long argument.
ex.zh: 她的調解幫助鄰居化解了長期的爭執。

ex.en: The car was painted a shiny metallic blue.
ex.zh: 這輛車漆成閃亮的金屬藍色。

ex.en: I noticed a metallic taste in my mouth after the medicine.
ex.zh: 吃完藥後，我嘴裡有一股金屬味。

ex.en: The robot made a cold metallic sound as it moved.
ex.zh: 機器人移動時發出冰冷的金屬聲。

ex.en: We saw a bright meteor streak across the sky.
ex.zh: 我們看到一顆明亮的流星劃過天際。

ex.en: A meteor burns up as it enters the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 流星進入大氣層時會燃燒殆盡。

ex.en: She made a wish when she saw the meteor.
ex.zh: 她看到流星時許了個願。

ex.en: The two companies hired a mediator to settle their dispute.
ex.zh: 兩家公司請了一位調停人來解決爭端。

ex.en: She acted as a mediator between her angry parents.
ex.zh: 她在氣頭上的父母之間扮演調解人的角色。

ex.en: The study has a few methodological problems.
ex.zh: 這項研究有幾個方法上的問題。

ex.en: They discussed the methodological approach of the project.
ex.zh: 他們討論了這個計畫的方法論取向。

ex.en: He lived on a meagre salary for many years.
ex.zh: 他靠微薄的薪水過了很多年。

ex.en: They shared a meagre meal of bread and soup.
ex.zh: 他們分食了簡陋的一餐，只有麵包和湯。

ex.en: The workers earn a meager income.
ex.zh: 這些工人的收入微薄。

ex.en: We had only a meager supply of food for the trip.
ex.zh: 我們這趟旅程帶的糧食少得可憐。

ex.en: We ate sweet melon after dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐後吃了甜甜的哈密瓜。

ex.en: Cut the melon into thin slices.
ex.zh: 把瓜切成薄片。

ex.en: Melbourne is a large city in the Australian state of Victoria.
ex.zh: 墨爾本是澳洲維多利亞州的一座大城市。

ex.en: The Australian Open tennis tournament is held in Melbourne.
ex.zh: 澳洲網球公開賽在墨爾本舉行。

ex.en: The food was mediocre, so we won't go back.
ex.zh: 食物普普通通，所以我們不會再去了。

ex.en: He gave a mediocre performance in the final.
ex.zh: 他在決賽中的表現平平。

ex.en: I don't want to live a mediocre life.
ex.zh: 我不想過平庸的生活。

melting.zh: 正在融化（melt 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The ice cream is melting in the sun.
ex.zh: 冰淇淋在太陽下融化了。

ex.en: Snow was melting off the roofs all afternoon.
ex.zh: 整個下午屋頂上的雪都在融化。

ex.en: We drank the melting snow water from the stream.
ex.zh: 我們喝了溪裡由融雪形成的水。

ex.en: She gave him a melting smile that made him blush.
ex.zh: 她給了他一個讓人心都融化的微笑，他臉紅了。

ex.en: She answered in a calm, measured voice.
ex.zh: 她用平靜又從容的聲音回答。

ex.en: He walked with slow, measured steps.
ex.zh: 他邁著緩慢而穩重的步伐。

ex.en: The tailor measured my arms before cutting the cloth.
ex.zh: 裁縫師在裁布之前量了我的手臂。

ex.en: We measured the room and it was four meters wide.
ex.zh: 我們量了房間，寬度是四公尺。

ex.en: Many Christians believe Jesus is the Messiah.
ex.zh: 許多基督徒相信耶穌是彌賽亞。

ex.en: The crowd treated the new coach like a messiah.
ex.zh: 群眾把新教練當成救世主一樣看待。

ex.zh: 墨西哥有許多人是梅斯蒂索人。

ex.en: The book describes the history of the mestizo population.
ex.zh: 這本書介紹了梅斯蒂索人口的歷史。

ex.en: Methanol is a toxic liquid that should never be drunk.
ex.zh: 甲醇是有毒的液體，絕對不能喝。

ex.en: The factory uses methanol as a solvent in its production line.
ex.zh: 工廠在生產線上用甲醇當溶劑。

ex.en: The company offers a mentoring program for new employees.
ex.zh: 公司為新進員工提供師徒輔導計畫。

ex.en: She gets great satisfaction from mentoring young students.
ex.zh: 她從指導年輕學生中得到很大的成就感。

ex.en: His mercurial temper made him hard to work with.
ex.zh: 他善變的脾氣讓人很難與他共事。

ex.en: The coach is brilliant but mercurial.
ex.zh: 那位教練很出色，但情緒起伏不定。

ex.en: Mechanized farming has greatly increased the amount of food we grow.
ex.zh: 機械化農耕大幅提高了糧食產量。

ex.en: The factory switched to a fully mechanized production line.
ex.zh: 工廠改用全機械化的生產線。

mechanized.zh: 使機械化（mechanize 的過去式）

ex.en: The farm mechanized its harvest in the 1950s.
ex.zh: 這座農場在一九五零年代將收成作業機械化。

ex.en: They mechanized the packing process to save time.
ex.zh: 他們把包裝流程機械化以節省時間。

ex.en: The magician's tricks can mesmerise any audience.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲可以迷住任何觀眾。

ex.en: The beautiful music seemed to mesmerise the children.
ex.zh: 優美的音樂似乎讓孩子們入了迷。

ex.en: A caterpillar metamorphoses into a butterfly.
ex.zh: 毛毛蟲會蛻變成蝴蝶。

ex.en: The shy girl metamorphosed into a confident leader.
ex.zh: 那個害羞的女孩蛻變成有自信的領導者。

ex.en: Many menopausal women have trouble sleeping at night.
ex.zh: 許多更年期的女性晚上睡不好。

ex.en: The clinic offers advice for menopausal symptoms like hot flashes.
ex.zh: 診所針對熱潮紅等更年期症狀提供諮詢。

ex.en: The liver helps the body metabolize alcohol.
ex.zh: 肝臟幫助身體代謝酒精。

ex.en: Some people metabolize caffeine faster than others.
ex.zh: 有些人代謝咖啡因的速度比別人快。

ex.en: The final match will test the mettle of both players.
ex.zh: 決賽將考驗兩位選手的氣魄。

ex.en: She showed her mettle by finishing the race with an injured foot.
ex.zh: 她拖著受傷的腳跑完全程，展現了她的膽識。

mediating.zh: 調解；斡旋（mediate 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The teacher is mediating between the two quarreling students.
ex.zh: 老師正在兩個吵架的學生之間居中調解。

ex.en: She spent the afternoon mediating a dispute between neighbors.
ex.zh: 她整個下午都在調解鄰居之間的糾紛。

ex.en: The United Nations is mediating talks between the two sides.
ex.zh: 聯合國正在斡旋雙方的談判。

merged.zh: 合併；融合（merge 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The two small banks merged to form a larger one.
ex.zh: 那兩家小銀行合併成一家較大的銀行。

ex.en: The road merged with the highway near the bridge.
ex.zh: 那條路在橋附近匯入了高速公路。

ex.en: She merged the two files into a single document.
ex.zh: 她把兩個檔案合併成一份文件。

ex.en: The nurse explained how menstruation works in the health class.
ex.zh: 護理師在健康教育課上說明月經是怎麼回事。

ex.en: Some girls feel tired during menstruation.
ex.zh: 有些女生在經期間會覺得疲倦。

ex.en: The body makes more melatonin when it gets dark.
ex.zh: 天黑時，身體會製造更多褪黑激素。

ex.en: Some people take melatonin to help with jet lag.
ex.zh: 有些人服用褪黑激素來緩解時差。

ex.en: Memorization alone will not help you understand the subject.
ex.zh: 光靠死背無法讓你理解這門學科。

ex.en: The teacher gave us tips for the memorization of new words.
ex.zh: 老師教我們背新單字的訣竅。

ex.en: Mealtime at our house is always noisy and fun.
ex.zh: 我們家的用餐時間總是吵吵鬧鬧又開心。

ex.en: Please turn off the TV at mealtime.
ex.zh: 用餐時間請把電視關掉。

ex.en: Let's meet up at the station at noon.
ex.zh: 我們中午在車站碰面吧。

ex.en: We often meet up for coffee on weekends.
ex.zh: 我們週末常約出來喝咖啡。

meet up.en: to come together with someone as planned

ex.en: Please don't mess up my desk.
ex.zh: 請不要把我的桌子弄亂。

ex.en: The rain messed up our picnic plans.
ex.zh: 這場雨把我們的野餐計畫搞砸了。

mess up.en: to spoil something or make it untidy

ex.en: I messed up the order and sent the wrong size.
ex.zh: 我把訂單弄錯，寄成了錯的尺寸。

ex.en: Everyone messes up sometimes, so don't worry.
ex.zh: 每個人偶爾都會出錯，別擔心。
